These fourteen PNGs were generated by the Python/Pillow backend at commit 6897ed1,
using the exact DejaVuSansMono.ttf now bundled in server/assets. They cover old
plain-text documents and formatted text, continuous and die-cut media, both
orientations, mixed sizes, underline, spacing, and vertical alignment. Six image
fixtures additionally cover grayscale, two-color, and bilevel resizing with
fractional caption placement.

Native Rust tests compare decoded RGB pixels, not PNG encoding bytes. Keep these
fixtures when changing the renderer: saved documents must retain their appearance.
The included drafts.json contains the original inputs. Test code resolves the
bundled font's installed ID because font-family consolidation varies by host.

variable.ttf is an original tiny fixture generated by tests/font_fixtures.py. Its
single rectangular glyph varies in width with the weight axis. The native unit
test checks its ink totals against Pillow at weights 100, 400, and 700.
